interface.name: limitless_expansion_v1
interface.description: Expansion is Malaysia's Mission Control: the windows of the current Desktop spread with no overlap under a strip that lists the Desktops. A launcher or a dock uses this global to open it, as the Dock opens Mission Control on macOS. It grants nothing, so every client may bind it.

request.name: toggle
request.description: Opens Expansion when it is closed and closes it when it is open, as Control+Up does.
